name: Sudokun
description: Swedish sudoku players deserve better. Every major sudoku site is either cluttered with ads inside the puzzle, requires an account before you can play, or is an English site with a thin Swedish translation layer slapped on top. I wanted one place where you open the URL and the puzzle is just there — no popups, no sign-up walls, no broken Swedish.
